Our Position

Security decisions should be based on risk — not assumption.

HESMK provides strategic security and risk advisory services that help leadership understand what needs protection, what can go wrong, where vulnerabilities exist and where security investment will have the greatest effect.

We don't simply add security. We help organizations understand their risk and make informed decisions about security.

The Risk Perspective

Threat→Vulnerability→Consequence→Risk→Controls→Resilience
